name: Music Import
author: lynlioss
summary: Download songs, albums, EPs and playlists from shared music links.
description: Reads Spotify and YouTube Music metadata and downloads matching public recordings with original audio, tags and artwork. Runs in a separate Android service with yt-dlp, Python, QuickJS and FFmpeg.
privacy: Sends submitted links and song searches to Spotify and YouTube. Checks GitHub for extractor updates. Files stay on your device.
